Hi, I'm **Aarushi Dandriyal**, a Business Analytics student at **Monash University**. Through this website, I'm practising how to turn technical research into something a reader can follow without needing a specialist background. My current post explores vaccination and border quarantine: a topic that connects statistical modelling with everyday questions about travel and community safety. I use the blog to work through what the evidence tells us, what its limits are, and why the findings matter.
